title: Task management app — teams, boards, due dates

define.note: Approved by the user at the gate on 2026-09-03, after being shown the no-password-reset risk and the polling-vs-push resolution. Fresh-eyes pass fixed 6 defects before presentation (SC5 auth-leak ambiguity, SC10 flaky timing window, SC11 unprovable claim, unspecified session lifetime, no leave-team path, silent column-delete cascade).

design.note: REVISED 2026-09-04 from design-refs/board-reference.png, treated as direction not a pixel target. Adopted (visual only, no new capability): five-hue accent scale cycled BY COLUMN POSITION (no new field; restates I3; stable across reloads), coloured card titles, roomier density (320px columns, 14px card padding), three-band card anatomy, initials avatar stack replacing comma-separated names, pill count chips, flat-fill depth strategy. Contrast COMPUTED not estimated (design-refs/contrast.py, validated black-on-white=21.00): every ink/surface pair 5.00-5.04. Two findings: --muted-foreground drops to 4.21 on tinted cards so a --tint-muted-foreground 0.500 token was added (5.34); and the due-date badges were re-solved against all five tints at once, not one card surface. NOT adopted: 10 items that are FEATURES not in spec.md (tags, progress bars, checklists, attachments, thumbnails, search, suite nav, collapsible columns, photo avatars, times on cards) — listed in design.md's appendix as scope questions AWAITING THE USER'S DECISION. Adopting any of them amends spec.md, which is gated. No code was changed by this run.

blueprint.note: plan.md approved by the user at the gate on 2026-09-04 (intake Q18), after being shown the Step 1b dependency findings and decision D1. Two open Shape choices were settled at the same gate: T03 session storage = DB-backed session table (Q19); T10 drag library = @hello-pangea/dnd (Q20). Both folded into plan.md. Fresh-eyes pass had fixed 3 defects before presentation.

construct.note: T01-T11 + T10a done (12/19 slices). 111 unit+integration and 37 e2e green, lint clean, build exit 0; the unit suite is additionally proven under UTC, America/Los_Angeles, Asia/Tokyo and Pacific/Kiritimati. T10a applied design.md's visual language (plan v2, user-directed): five-hue scale cycled by column, three-band cards, initials avatar stack, tint-safe muted token. Contrast is asserted against the PAINTED PIXEL in the browser, not the stylesheet, and mutation-checked. T11 delivered SC4. Next slice: T12 (teams and members).

harden.note: SCHEDULED, not optional: self-hosted email+password auth is a security-sensitive surface (hashing, session fixation, login brute-force, and the member-lookup enumeration oracle in SC7). Must run before any release.

open_items_for_resume: IN PROGRESS: construct. T01-T11 + T10a done. Next slice: T12 (teams and members: add by email, remove, roles). Task Status: lines in plan.md are the per-slice resume marker.
RESOLVED 2026-09-04: git isolation. main now has baseline commit d4da6a1; branch task/0001-task-management-mvp created off it and is the working branch.

RESOLVED 2026-09-04: I5 dense-integer ordering settled in plan.md as decision D1 — dense integers rewritten in one transaction, with NO unique(parentId, position) constraint; density asserted by test instead. Sparse/fractional keys recorded as the rejected alternative with a revisit trigger.
OPEN: no password reset exists. Largest MVP product risk, accepted knowingly at the spec gate.

NOTE: `prisma` CLI npm 'latest' is 8.0.0-rc.12 — both prisma packages are pinned to 7.10.0 in package.json. Do not run `prisma@latest`.
RULE (learned T07, in standards.md + decisions.md): team-scoped reads embed the membership predicate IN THE QUERY. A layout check is never the boundary — layouts and pages render concurrently.
RULE (learned T07): the proving set is all four of lint, test, test:e2e, build. A lint error was committed past once before this was written down.
RULE (learned T10): a visual check is its own verification step. Behaviour-only assertions cannot see a font/colour/layout regression — verify must render and look.

OPEN (design, 2026-09-04): design.md's appendix lists 10 reference features that are NOT in spec.md — tags, progress bars, checklists, attachments, thumbnails, search, suite nav, collapsible columns, photo avatars, times on cards. Each needs a scope decision from the user; adopting any amends the gated spec. The board's column caret is drawn decorative-only pending B8.
RULE (learned T11): a timezone test must not itself be timezone-dependent. Build 'today' from LOCAL fields, due dates from UTC fields, and run the suite under at least LA and Tokyo.
